body.x: QIHAN participated in ‘CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show)’, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics show held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. from Tues. 9th to Fri. 12th in Jan. and introduced a robot 'Sanbot Max' with accuracy and efficiency.

‘Sanbot Max’ is a service robot, which has been developed for government work, companies and so on. This intelligent robot's strengths are more powerful self-learning ability, more accurate operating standards, faster transport speed, and stronger strength and this robot can be considered as well-trained ‘super secretary’. This robot can walk in all directions at 360 degrees and is equipped with multiple sensor obstacle avoidance techniques. It can freely move in a complex internal environment. In addition, it can move heavy objects and work on customer service work since it has voice recognition function, which can be useful.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
